# GdayMeetings 0.3.7

Fixes false Better Auth startup warnings saying OAuth array fields have type TEXT instead of string[] on SQLite. TEXT is the correct representation created by Better Auth for these fields. The startup checker now recognizes it; real type mismatches still warn.

Existing users, OAuth clients and grants are preserved. No database migration or reset is needed. A regression reopens a persisted auth database and verifies token refresh with the existing grant.

Includes the admin component-map fix from 0.3.6. Container: ghcr.io/rankun203/gday-meetings:0.3.7; latest updates after AMD64 and ARM64 container checks pass.
